current_seed_only_definition: Pairs in Variant C whose committed discovery provenance is exactly current_currency_non_causal_seed and which are absent from Variant D.
liquidity_audit_scope: current-seed-only assets entering Top-10 or Top-6
assets involved in P2S LARGE_LIQUIDITY_GAP substitutions
current-seed-only assets with at least 26 Top-6 weeks
highest-impact current-seed-only assets from the committed P2S audit

liquidity_rules.data_source: committed P1R KuCoin Classic Spot daily panel only
liquidity_rules.max_day_share: max daily quote turnover divided by trailing 28-day median quote turnover
liquidity_rules.turnover_stability: population coefficient of variation of valid trailing-window daily quote turnover
liquidity_rules.short_lived_spike: post-entry median turnover at least 5x pre-entry median and fewer than 26 post-entry active days
liquidity_rules.price_range_volume_divergence: highest-turnover day has a daily range below half the trailing-window median range while turnover is at least 5x the trailing median
liquidity_rules.repeated_volume_pattern: at least half of non-zero trailing-window observations share one rounded turnover value
liquidity_rules.relative_volume_reference: asset trailing median divided by the corresponding BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT trailing medians when both reference panels are available
liquidity_rules.sparse_activity: fewer than 26 valid trailing-window days; the committed panel has no intraday observations, so absence of an intraday check does not itself create a flag
